checks.test: const r = checkout({ lines: [{ sku: 'TENT-2P', quantity: 1, unitPriceCents: 10000 }] }, 'WELCOME10', '2026-10-05'); return r.ok === true && r.value.totalCents === 9000;

const r = checkout({ lines: [{ sku: 'TENT-2P', quantity: 1, unitPriceCents: 10000 }] }, 'SPRING15', '2026-10-05'); return r.ok === false && r.error.type === 'coupon-expired' && r.error.expiredOn === '2025-05-31';
const r = checkout({ lines: [{ sku: 'MUG-SET', quantity: 1, unitPriceCents: 2500 }] }, 'NOPE', '2026-10-05'); return r.ok === false && r.error.type === 'out-of-stock';

return errorMessage({ type: 'coupon-unknown', code: 'NOPE' }).includes('NOPE') && errorMessage({ type: 'out-of-stock', sku: 'MUG-SET', available: 0 }).includes('MUG-SET') && errorMessage({ type: 'coupon-expired', code: 'SPRING15', expiredOn: '2025-05-31' }).includes('2025-05-31');
